hypothesis: Sharing recurrent and readout features while routing a zero-initialized cheap 4x2 residual by causal predicted class may address class-dependent errors.
primary: soft pair minus uniform pair; fixed epoch1; seeds3,4
controls: Identical parameter count, initialization, teacher, optimizer, steps; no-extra-head wave22 controls secondary.
data: all train + valid folds !=0; evaluate 425 sequences/123 chains excluding all train chains; reused validation, no fresh holdout or true train-mask claim
class_gate: Detached softmax output logits17:21 normalized to unit L2 norm; uniform control coefficients0.5 each (also squared norm1). Equal per-row residual Jacobian norm avoids 4x effective learning-rate confound.
capacity: Linear256->8 only; shared existing f; zero initialization; no penalty; both arms normalize routing to squared norm1.
deployment: Native export/parity/runtime required if positive; existing submitted ZIP preserved
protocol_revision: Before any wave23 training, inspection found ordinary softmax routing changes effective head learning rate with confidence; normalize both arms to unit L2 norm.
data_order_note: Primary soft/uniform arms have identical model constructor RNG consumption and data order. Secondary no-extra-head wave22 control consumes fewer initialization draws, hence does not have identical batch order.
